group: Valid JSON, validation enabled, customizer provided

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true and no ValidationMessage; executionCustomizer must be invoked (custom attribute set)
cases.description: Ensures that a well‑formed JSON string is deserialized, the schema is validated, and the supplied Consumer is called.

group: Valid JSON, validation disabled, no customizer

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true (no validation performed) and empty messages; consumer not invoked
cases.description: When validation flag is false the method should skip schema checks and simply return a successful result.

cases.expected: throws com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException (or a wrapped ValidationException) and returns ValidationResult with isValid=false and a message indicating parsing error
cases.description: The method must correctly propagate a parsing failure from the internal deserialize() call.

cases.expected: throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'input must not be null'
cases.description: The method should guard against a null JSON payload before attempting deserialization.

cases.expected: throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'inputFormat must not be null'
cases.description: The method must validate that a non‑null InputFormat is supplied.

cases.expected: throws UnsupportedEncodingException wrapped in ValidationException; ValidationResult.isValid=false
cases.description: When URLDecoder fails due to malformed percent‑encoding, the method should surface the error.

cases.expected: throws RuntimeException with message 'customizer failure'; ValidationResult not returned
cases.description: Verifies that an exception thrown by the supplied Consumer propagates out of the walk method.

group: Valid YAML, validation enabled, no customizer

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true and no ValidationMessage; executionCustomizer not invoked
cases.description: Ensures that a well‑formed YAML payload is correctly deserialized, validated against the schema, and that the method works when no Consumer is supplied.

group: Valid JSON, validation disabled, customizer provided

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true (no validation performed) and empty messages; executionCustomizer must be invoked (attribute "skip" set to true)
cases.description: When validation is turned off the Consumer should still be executed, allowing callers to modify the ExecutionContext even though the schema is not checked.

group: Empty JSON string triggers deserialization exception

cases.expected: throws com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException (or wrapped ValidationException) and returns ValidationResult with isValid=false and a parsing error message
cases.description: An empty string is not valid JSON; the method must propagate the parsing failure from deserialize().

cases.expected: throws com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException (or wrapped ValidationException) and returns ValidationResult with isValid=false and a parsing error message
cases.description: A string containing only whitespace should be treated as invalid JSON and cause a parsing exception.

group: Valid URL_ENCODED input, validation enabled, no customizer

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true and no ValidationMessage; the URL‑encoded string is correctly decoded to a JSON object {"name":"John","age":30}
cases.description: Confirms that the URL_ENCODED format is decoded, transformed into a JsonNode, and validated when the payload is well‑formed.

group: JSON array input fails schema validation

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=false and at least one ValidationMessage indicating type mismatch (schema expects an object)
cases.description: The schema associated with the JsonSchema instance expects a JSON object; providing a JSON array should cause validation to fail.

group: Consumer sets custom attribute, validation enabled

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true and no ValidationMessage; executionCustomizer must be invoked and the attribute "requestId" set to "abc-123" in the ExecutionContext
cases.description: Verifies that a Consumer can enrich the ExecutionContext before validation runs and that the enrichment is observable after the walk call.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid=true and no ValidationMessage; executionCustomizer is called but makes no changes
cases.description: Ensures that a Consumer that performs no operation does not interfere with normal validation flow.

cases.expected: throws IllegalArgumentException with message containing 'Unsupported input format'
cases.description: The walk method should reject an InputFormat that it does not support (e.g., XML) and raise an IllegalArgumentException before any deserialization occurs.

group: createExecutionContext returns null leading to NPE

cases.expected: throws NullPointerException when walk attempts to use a null ExecutionContext
cases.description: If a subclass of JsonSchema overrides createExecutionContext() to return null, the subsequent walk call should fail with a NullPointerException because the method expects a non‑null ExecutionContext.

cases.expected: throws ValidationException (or IllegalStateException) indicating that the root node is null and cannot be walked
cases.description: When the JSON payload is the literal 'null', deserialize() returns a JsonNode representing JSON null. The walk method is expected to treat this as an invalid root for schema validation and raise an exception rather than returning a successful ValidationResult.
